title: Prevent unsafe Windows legacy Scheduled Task handovers before process ownership can be verified.
changes: Use the authenticated per-user Startup/Job Object supervisor for all new Windows installations instead of creating a WScript → CMD Scheduled Task.
Query legacy Task Scheduler registration using locale-independent COM; refuse ambiguous, access-denied and existing-task results rather than starting a duplicate agent.
Refuse legacy uninstall and credential restart without a proven empty descendant group. Preserve existing tasks, launcher files and pairing instead of falsely claiming that descendants stopped.
Preflight legacy task ownership before npm updates so a failed handover cannot partially replace the installed release.

Add real isolated Windows Startup install/stop/uninstall QA and negative permission/ownership regressions. Automatic migration of an already-running legacy task remains intentionally blocked pending ownership-verified handover.
